descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
ALTEN Romania, part of the international ALTEN Group - with a unique position as a Leader in IT and engineering Consulting- has supported its clients’ development strategies in innovation, R&D, and IT systems since 1996.
 Description: 
 You will join an Agile team that includes all software-related roles (System Engineers, Developers, Integrators).
 Required competencies: 
Design and develop our LDT software solution;
Participate in the validation and global integration of the software you help develop;
Analyze anomalies and maintain previous versions of the software to ensure customer satisfaction throughout the product lifecycle;
Maintain and improve our development environment (Continuous Integration, DevOps practices);
Contribute to the software architecture based on existing product components;
Collaborate with other product teams within the solutions ecosystem, working in a scaled Agile framework (SAFe).
 Requested experience: 
You have a degree in Computer Science and bring experience in the following areas:
Engineering degree or equivalent background, with initial experience in software development or completion of a relevant project.
Experience with Continuous Integration tools, such as Jenkins.
Solid knowledge of configuration management, especially with GIT.
Strong adaptability and ability to work effectively in a team setting.
Demonstrated rigor, with strong analytical and synthesis skills.
Capable of taking initiative and showing tenacity in achieving objectives.
Proficiency in Python (PyQGIS, arcpy ...), PowerShell, bash
Strong knowledges about QGIS (ArcGIS Pro too but less prioritary than QGIS)
Knowledges on GeoServer (knowledges on GeoNode could be a bonus)
Windows and Linux system skills
Able to do L1 / L2 / L3 support to users on GIS subjects
Knowledges on GIS architecture and GIS softwares deployments and customisations (GeoServer, QGIS, ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Pro)
GIS licensing servers (flexnet)
GIS database management (PostGIS, SDE, SQL ...), FME or other ETL is a bonus
If possible, knowledges of Microsoft Azure or other cloud environment
You are committed to delivering high-quality technical solutions and passionate about contributing to innovative projects in the aerospace sector.
 Behavioral skills: 
English fluent
Strong team player
Be autonomous and proactive on your tasks,
Teamwork and knowledge sharing.
Sense of responsibility
Good communication skills
Has a continuous learning mindset and learning of new paradigms, techniques & practices in build-test-release cycles and software automation
Understand the necessity of stability in the infrastructures.
 🚀 Only eligible candidates will be contacted in a maximum of 2 weeks. Any information you provide is confidential.
